title: Homepage and evidence polish
details: Keeps the concise two-line course identity stable on the home screen
Uses one post-evidence learning screen with Hours and Minutes and records OTJ for Standards or GLH for NVQ
Restores evidence thumbnails and shows a square Audio tile for audio-only evidence
Shows measured pack-building progress with a yellow spinner and real percentage while NVQ evidence packs are prepared
summary: Evia v160 fixes the remaining homepage and evidence-flow issues without changing course mappings or evidence data.
